notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
UPDATE

we took some time to read your reviews and we made some fixes.
- some complaint about low performance after planet 3: FIXED
- some complaind about ballance, the lazer beams overpowerd : we added new mechanics to the beams reducing ther ovevpower




EDIT: for people who experience problem after update regarding game not start normal:
We made some performance upgrades wich also include compile game with difrent program and some grafic card that are not updated/setup propely may experience this problem . 

try this:
right click on your desktop
click on "NVDIA control panel" 
You should be on "3D settings"
Here you can chose a program for settings some options
Search for flesheaters.exe in your steam folder and select it
then turn it on high performances


Thank you
